purpose: Defines how the consult skill is used for new creation dialogues (brainstorming, drafting, new requirements), including handling of decisions, display, recording, and the final document result.
summary: Input is the conversation context and the deliverable is a document
Decisions are not reflected per topic; the document is written only on user instruction
No resolution is demanded; each topic states what to decide, gist, and AI view
Topic status "discussed" versus "settled" (settled only when the user explicitly says so)
Display follows the dialogue revision rules with an added "discussed" status
Presentation state is held in conversation context
consult brief is not recorded for new creation
On finish, show which topics go into the document and which are excluded before writing
tasks: Running consult for brainstorming or discussion
Drafting a first-pass document through dialogue
Creating a new requirements document via dialogue
Deciding how to present discussion topics and status
Writing a document from discussion results
title: 新規作成の手順
